WITH MediaTypeRates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
  Name,
  bytes_per_millisecond_rate AS rate,
  bytes_per_millisecond_rate - AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) OVER () AS amount_above_average
FROM MediaTypeRates
WHERE bytes_per_millisecond_rate > AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) OVER ()
